scope: Sixteen bounded replays of unchanged JS/TS teaching blocks. Native Node type stripping is not TypeScript type checking. No compiler is installed in the repository; static claims are documentation-reviewed, not compiler-verified. No all-lesson execution, timer scheduling, remote cancellation, production implementation or learner assessment claim.

results.name: closure-sharing
results.assertions: assert.equal(counter.read(),2); const other=makeCounter(); assert.equal(other.read(),0); counter.increment(); assert.equal(counter.read(),3); assert.equal(other.read(),0);

results.name: prototype-lookup
results.assertions: assert.equal(account.role,'viewer'); assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(account,'role'),false); assert.equal('role' in account,true); assert.equal(Object.getPrototypeOf(account),shared); account.role='admin'; assert.equal(account.role,'admin'); assert.equal(shared.role,'viewer'); delete account.role; assert.equal(account.role,'viewer'); assert.equal(account.missing,undefined);

results.name: promise-adoption
results.assertions: assert.equal(await outer,'ready'); let complete; const i=new Promise(r=>complete=r); let rejectOuter; const o=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{rejectOuter=reject;resolve(i)}); let seen=false; o.then(()=>{seen=true}); await Promise.resolve(); assert.equal(seen,false); rejectOuter(new Error('ignored')); complete('locked'); assert.equal(await o,'locked');

results.name: await-before-cleanup
results.assertions: const events=[]; assert.equal(await withResource(async()=>({perform:async()=>{await Promise.resolve();events.push('perform');return 7},close:async()=>{events.push('close')}})),7); assert.deepEqual(events,['perform','close']); await assert.rejects(()=>withResource(async()=>({perform:async()=>{throw Error('primary')},close:async()=>{throw Error('cleanup')}})),/cleanup/);

results.name: cooperative-abort
results.assertions: const c=new AbortController(); let effect=0; const pending=step(c.signal,async()=>{effect++;c.abort(new Error('stopped'));return 'done'}); await assert.rejects(()=>pending,/stopped/); assert.equal(effect,1); let called=false; await assert.rejects(()=>step(c.signal,async()=>{called=true}),/stopped/); assert.equal(called,false);

results.name: consumer-pacing
results.assertions: const events=[]; let active=0; async function* source(){events.push('pull1');yield 1;events.push('pull2');yield 2;} await processAll(source(),async n=>{active++;assert.equal(active,1);events.push('save'+n);await Promise.resolve();active--;events.push('done'+n)},new AbortController().signal); assert.deepEqual(events,['pull1','save1','done1','pull2','save2','done2']);

results.name: iterator-close
results.assertions: let closed=false; async function* values(){try{yield 1;yield 2}finally{await Promise.resolve();closed=true}} assert.equal(await takeFirst(values()),1); assert.equal(closed,true);

results.name: parser-paths
results.assertions: const raw={name:' Ada ',age:30,extra:true}; const parsed=parseCustomerInput(raw); assert.deepEqual(parsed,{name:'Ada',age:30}); assert.notEqual(raw,parsed); assert.equal(raw.name,' Ada '); for(const bad of [null,[],1,{name:'',age:20},{name:3,age:20}]) assert.throws(()=>parseCustomerInput(bad),TypeError); for(const age of [-1,131,1.5,NaN,'30']) assert.throws(()=>parseCustomerInput({name:'Ada',age}),RangeError); assert.equal(parseCustomerInput({name:'A',age:0}).age,0); assert.equal(parseCustomerInput({name:'A',age:130}).age,130);

results.name: two-rejection-layers
results.assertions: const entries=await collect([async()=>({kind:'rejected',recipientId:'r1',reason:'policy'}),async()=>{throw new Error('transport')}]); assert.equal(entries[0].status,'fulfilled'); assert.equal(entries[0].value.kind,'rejected'); assert.equal(entries[1].status,'rejected'); assert.equal(entries[1].reason.message,'transport'); await assert.rejects(()=>collect([()=>{throw Error('sync')}]),/sync/);
